$comment: Canonical design tokens for both apps. See README.md before editing. docs/design-system.md explains what each value is for and why; this file is what the apps are generated from. Contrast ratios are deliberately NOT stored here -- they are computed from the hex values by contrast.test, so a claim can never drift from the colour it describes.

contrastRoles.$comment: What each colour is allowed to be used for, checked against WCAG 2.1 AA by computing the ratio. bodyTextOnWhite must clear 4.5:1; largeTextOrIconOnly must clear 3:1 and is refused for body text; tintBackground is a fill that gray900 body text sits on, so it must stay light enough for that pairing to clear 4.5:1.
contrastRoles.$fillOnlyComment: accent500 is deliberately absent from every foreground role. At 2.97:1 on white it does not clear even the 3:1 non-text threshold, so it may never be an icon, a border or text on a white surface -- only a filled badge with gray900 on top, which is the pairing filledButton checks. tintBackground is for light fills under gray900 body text; accent500 is saturated, so it is listed under filledButton instead.
